finalText:
Build's clean now — 0 errors, exit code 0.

The real bug was in `src/core/settings.js`: `resolveConfig` referenced an undefined variable `retries` instead of reading it from the passed-in `env`, so every build crashed at the link stage. I added a `retries: 3` default and changed the line to `maxRetries: env.retries || DEFAULTS.retries`.

The 3 warnings are still there but harmless — a deprecated `crypto.createCipher` call, an unused export `formatLegacyDate`, and a circular import between `graph.js` and `tracker.js`. Let me know if you want those cleaned up too.
